qualification.headless_usage: Real local ready report observed with exit 0

claim_boundary: Measures canonical LocalUsageReport JSON decoding and fresh NSHostingView creation, layout, and display for a bounded 365-period and 100-session fixture. It excludes CLI and ccusage startup, filesystem scanning, window-server frame pacing, interactive scrolling, Devin activity, and live provider telemetry.
